original_benchmark.notes: MuSiQue-Ans v1.0 development split. Upstream provides AllenNLP models and a deterministic evaluator, but no Harbor-compatible agent. Upstream commit: 922ac98f19a201998dbdae6d7f2887a5258dbdeb. Training, hidden-label test, and paired MuSiQue-Full splits are outside this initial adapter's scope.

harbor_adapter.notes: WIP through guide Steps 1-3. Oracle verification on 2026-10-26 covered all 2,417 tasks with answer_em=answer_f1=support_f1=1.0 and zero final exceptions; five pre-verifier Podman timeouts and eight interruption cancellations were archived and retried with unchanged tasks. Evidence is under evidence/. No model parity experiments have run, so there are no matching or unmatching agent claims. The dataset is not published.
